utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, it's a community thing — folks are pooling tools and know-how to help fix up fences and porches around the block.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When's it happening, and do you need any specific tools?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got a bunch of tools that might come in handy if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Gus! Yeah, that'd be great—what kind of tools do you have?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got a solid set of wrenches, a couple of hammers, and some screwdrivers. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, did you hear they're organizing a repair drive this weekend? I think we can bring in broken appliances and such.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds nice, but do we know where exactly we should drop off the items and what time they'll be accepting them?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think it's at the community center from 10 AM to 4 PM, but I'd double-check the flyer—I saw it on the bulletin board.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Opal, you mentioned the repair drive—need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually, yes! Could you help me move some old furniture out of the shed so I can get to the broken lawnmower?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Opal. I'll grab my work gloves and meet you out back in a couple minutes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the community garden shed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, the garden shed? I didn't know about that. Is it true that it's falling apart?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, the roof's got a leak and the door's jammed, but nothing a few of us can't handle. Can I count you in for Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hello Leo! I'm glad you're here about the repair drive. How can I help you get involved or share an update?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got some old tools from my garage. When and where should I drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Leo! We're collecting at the community center this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM. Just bring them by anytime.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Dane, before we start with the repair drive, could you walk me through exactly what we're fixing and the steps you have in mind?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late. So, we're fixing the old lawnmower engine—first we'll drain the oil, then replace the spark plug, and finally adjust the carburetor.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—drain oil, then spark plug, then carburetor. Do we have all the right tools and replacement parts ready?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, the repair drive! That's coming up soon, right? Do we know the exact dates yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it's this Saturday from 9 to 4. I've got the sign-up sheet right here if you want to grab a slot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh perfect, I can definitely help out for a few hours in the morning after I drop the kids off. Put me down for 9 to 12.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Jules, what's this repair drive everyone's been talking about?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, you haven't heard? It's a big neighborhood effort to fix up old bikes and appliances—everyone's donating spare parts and tools down at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great—do you know if they're taking donations this weekend? I've got an old toaster that might be useful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, what's this about a repair drive? I only got bits of it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you haven't heard? The city's organizing a big repair event for the community center this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, Saturday? That's crisp—count me in for at least a few hours.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Repair drive? What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, you know, it's that thing where folks in the neighborhood get together to fix up old appliances and furniture. I think I saw a flyer about it somewhere... maybe on my fridge?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Huh, I hadn't heard about that. Do people just show up with broken stuff, or is it more organized?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Cleo, I heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday. Are you planning to go?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh definitely, I've been sorting through my spare parts all week. Can't wait to see what everyone brings.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's great, I'll be there too! I heard Maria is bringing her old toaster to fix up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, I heard about the repair drive. What's the latest on that?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I think they're still collecting broken items in the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know—I've got a busted lamp I've been meaning to drop off. Is there a deadline for donations?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh hey, Vik! The repair drive—remind me, is that the one for the old playground swingset or the community garden fence?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, it's for the community garden fence. We're all set to fix it up this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, the fence! I remember now—I think I left my toolbox in the shed last fall. I'll go check before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Leo. Wait, what repair drive was that again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The one for the old toaster in my garage. You said you'd take a look.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the toaster! Sorry, it's been a hectic week. I'll grab my tools now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Eli, I heard you're working on the repair drive. Need me to grab my toolbox from the garage?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That'd be mighty helpful, Gus. I've got the blueprints spread out on my porch, but a second pair of hands never hurts.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, let me fetch it quick—got that new wrench set I’ve been meaning to break in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'm so glad you're here, Quinn. I was thinking we could finally get that old fence repaired for Mrs. Henderson—she's been asking for ages.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, that's a wonderful idea! I'll start spreading the word around the neighborhood—I bet we can get a crew together by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Quinn! I'll grab my tools and meet you at her place on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the repair drive? I've heard a bit about it. Are you getting folks together to help out?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I've been keeping a list of who's available and where they're usually found. Do you have a regular spot I can note down?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'm usually at the community garden on weekends, tending to the tomatoes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Cleo, I'm so glad you stopped by—we're putting together a repair drive for the community center this Saturday, and I could really use your help organizing the tool sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, absolutely, Rosa! I've been itching to help out, and I already have a list of who's got what tools from the last block party.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's perfect, Cleo—you're always so well-prepared! Could you share that list with me so we can match folks with the tasks?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Mina, I heard from someone about a repair drive happening. Is that true?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I heard about it too. Are you planning to bring something in for fixing?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I wasn’t sure if it was legit, but I’ve got a wobbly chair that could use some love.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, is the repair drive still on for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's still on! We're meeting at the school parking lot at 9 AM sharp.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I heard we're doing a repair drive this weekend. Need me to bring my toolbox or an extra pair of hands?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? Who organized that? I didn't see any flyers or emails about it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, I thought I saw a notice pinned up at the community center. Maybe I misread it?
